verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs say all Pro, Team and Enterprise projects are backed up automatically every day, with 7, 14 or up to 30 days of retention by plan, and backups appear in the Dashboard under Database > Backups. The same docs describe Point-in-Time Recovery built on physical backups plus WAL archiving, letting you restore to any chosen point with up to seconds of granularity. Missing for 10: automated backups and PITR on the Free plan (PITR is a paid add-on), independent or hands-on corroboration of restores, and documented restore workflow and recovery-time details.
